description.value: New Mandarin Seafood Restaurant (時代文華海鮮酒家) is a Cantonese seafood and dim sum restaurant located in East Vancouver's Gladstone neighbourhood. The kitchen leans heavily on traditional Hong Kong-style preparations — roasted and hotpot squab, fresh BC crab, whole lobster combos, and a daily dim sum service — earning a local reputation cited on the restaurant's own site. Online ordering and pickup are available, making it a practical meal stop as well as a sit-down destination.
